title: Lexicographically smallest topological order
prompt: Write `topo_order(n, edges)`. Nodes are 0..n-1 and each edge [a, b] means a must come before b. Return the topological order that is lexicographically smallest (always pick the smallest available node). If the graph has a cycle return [].
reference:
import heapq

def topo_order(n, edges):
    indeg = [0] * n
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for a, b in edges:
        adj[a].append(b)
        indeg[b] += 1
    h = [i for i in range(n) if indeg[i] == 0]
    heapq.heapify(h)
    out = []
    while h:
        x = heapq.heappop(h)
        out.append(x)
        for y in adj[x]:
            indeg[y] -= 1
            if indeg[y] == 0:
                heapq.heappush(h, y)
    return out if len(out) == n else []
